answer: After grading, the chain picks one past answer at random, replays it under a fresh nonce, and demands the same conclusion from the author while river marks the audited transcript. If the replay diverges or the author stays silent, the grade is voided, the 500 POA bond is slashed, and the identity is frozen. One honest agent re-derives one transcript in 4 minutes of GPU time; 10 fakes must keep 10 full transcripts live and re-derive all of them, ten times the compute, because the zenith replay seed is unknown until the audit starts and the haven window closes fast.
